_generator.name: hand-authored
_generator.comment: ARM template for the F1 Fantasy AGENT Function App (separate from the Telegram bot). Provisions a Linux Y1 Consumption Function App with `production` + `test` slots, both reusing the existing App Service Plan, storage account, App Insights, and Key Vault. Grants each slot's system-assigned MSI the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the existing `f1-fantasy-kv` so app settings can use @Microsoft.KeyVault references.

metadata.description: Name of the new Function App that hosts the CopilotKit agent webhook.
Azure region for the Function App. Must match the App Service Plan's region.
Name of the EXISTING App Service Plan to host the new Function App (reused from the Telegram bot).
Resource group of the EXISTING App Service Plan.
Name of the EXISTING storage account used for AzureWebJobsStorage (shared with the Telegram bot).
Resource group of the EXISTING storage account.
Name of the EXISTING Key Vault that holds all agent secrets. MUST be RBAC-enabled (this template grants the function app's MSI the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role).
Name of the EXISTING Application Insights component (reused from the Telegram bot — splitting it out is deferred).
Resource group of the EXISTING Application Insights component.
Blob container the agent reads league/team data from. Same container the Telegram bot uses.
Deployment name of the Azure OpenAI chat model. Matches the Telegram bot's current value.
NODE_ENV value passed to the Node.js runtime.

Comma-separated EXACT origins allowed by CORS on the production slot. Default `*` only for the bootstrap deploy (before the Static Web App exists). After SWA is provisioned, redeploy with this set to e.g. `https://f1-fantazy-agent-web.azurestaticapps.net`. NOTE: this value populates BOTH `siteConfig.cors.allowedOrigins` (Azure's CORS layer — handles preflight) AND the function-code env var `AGENT_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (local-dev fallback). On Azure, the platform layer takes precedence; the function-code matcher is effectively dead but harmless. Wildcards/regex are NOT supported by Azure's CORS layer — only literal `*` for `match-all`.
Function-code-only env var. Azure CORS does not support regex. Default empty (no preview origins on prod). Production should rarely need this.

Comma-separated EXACT origins allowed by CORS on the test slot. Same shape as prodAllowedOrigins. Default is `*` because SWA preview environments have unpredictable per-PR hostnames that Azure's CORS layer cannot regex-match; restricting the test slot to a tight allowlist would mean updating it per PR. `*` is acceptable on test since the slot is for short-lived PR validation.
Function-code-only env var. Set only for the function-code matcher in local-dev / direct-curl scenarios. Azure CORS overrides on the deployed slot.

resources.comments: Main Function App (production slot). siteConfig.appSettings is intentionally absent — ARM never touches appSettings to avoid wiping externally-managed keys like WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE (set by the GH deploy action). App settings are managed instead by `infra/agent-func/apply-settings.sh`, which uses `az functionapp config appsettings set` (additive — only updates listed keys). The npm script `deploy:agent-func` chains both.
resources.name: [parameters('functionAppName')]

resources.comments: Test deployment slot (per-PR deploys land here). Same isolation as the prod resource — no appSettings managed by ARM; the apply-settings.sh script handles both slots.
resources.name: [concat(parameters('functionAppName'), '/test')]

resources.comments: Grant the production slot's system MSI the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the existing Key Vault, so @Microsoft.KeyVault references in app settings can resolve.
resources.name: [guid(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), resourceId('Microsoft.Web/sites', parameters('functionAppName')), variables('kvSecretsUserRoleId'))]

resources.comments: Same role assignment for the test slot's system MSI (slots have independent identities).
resources.name: [guid(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), resourceId('Microsoft.Web/sites/slots', parameters('functionAppName'), 'test'), variables('kvSecretsUserRoleId'))]
